steps.text: Follow these steps exactly, then stop. 1. Call the subagent tool once with run_in_background set to true, description 'Report a finding', and prompt 'Call the report tool once with output exactly CHILD_REPORT_OK, then stop.'. 2. Reply with the single word STARTED. Do not use the bash tool.
Repeat back, verbatim, the exact output the background subagent reported to you. Reply with only that text. Do not use any tools.
